newsitem.title: INDIA: India's BPCL puts off equity issue.
newsitem.headline: India's BPCL puts off equity issue.

text.p: India's state-owned refining firm Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) said on Friday it decided to defer its proposed 4.12 billion rupees equity issue due to poor market conditions.
"The board of directors of the company ... has decided to defer the issue until market sentiments improve and the opportunity for a good retail response is available," BPCL said in a statement.
The firm said the decision was taken at a board meeting in Delhi on the advice of its lead managers.
The issue was scheduled to open for subscription in late October and the firm hoped to price each 10-rupee face value stock at 275 rupees.
BPCL shares closed 7.0 rupees higher at 283 on the Bombay Stock Exchange on Friday.
